description: This file defines the PortGuardian actor class responsible for managing network port monitoring, connection records, and related diagnostics in a macOS environment. It includes methods for recording active ports, sweeping (terminating) unexpected listeners, diagnosing port statuses, and parsing listener data. It also provides debugging/testing utilities.

classes.name: PortGuardian
classes.description: An actor responsible for managing and monitoring network port usage, including recording, diagnosing, sweeping (terminating listeners), and reporting port status.

classes.name: PortGuardian.Record
classes.description: A Codable structure capturing details of a port record including port number, pid, command, mode, and timestamp.

classes.name: PortGuardian.Descriptor
classes.description: A structure holding process information such as pid, command, and optional executable path.

classes.name: PortGuardian.PortReport
classes.description: A structure summarizing the status of a specific port, including expected command, status, and list of listeners.

classes.name: PortGuardian.ReportListener
classes.description: A structure representing a listener with details about the process and whether it's expected.

classes.name: PortGuardian.Listener
classes.description: A private internal structure representing a network listener with pid, command, full command, and user.

methods.name: sweep
methods.description: Scans open ports and kills unexpected listeners based on the provided connection mode.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Records a port usage event including port, pid, command, and mode.

methods.name: removeRecord
methods.description: Removes port records associated with a given pid.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Provides a descriptor for the port, including executable path if available.

methods.name: diagnose
methods.description: Returns diagnostic reports for monitored ports, including their listening status and health.

methods.name: probeGatewayHealth
methods.description: Checks health of the gateway service by making an HTTP request.

methods.name: isListening
methods.description: Checks if a port is being listened to, optionally filtering by pid.

methods.name: listeners
methods.description: Retrieves listening processes on a specified port using lsof.

methods.name: readFullCommand
methods.description: Retrieves full command line of a process given its pid.

methods.name: parseListeners
methods.description: Parses lsof output into listener structures.

methods.name: buildReport
methods.description: Constructs a port report based on listeners and expected behavior.

methods.name: executablePath
methods.description: Finds the executable path of a process on Darwin systems.

methods.name: kill
methods.description: Attempts to terminate a process given its pid.

methods.name: isExpected
methods.description: Determines if a listener process is expected for a given port and mode.

methods.name: probeGatewayHealthIfNeeded
methods.description: Checks gateway health if applicable based on current listeners and mode.

methods.name: loadRecords
methods.description: Loads port records from a JSON file.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves current port records to disk.
